about.title: We are the voice of UAlg's Bioengineering students
about.p1: NEBe — Núcleo de Estudantes de Bioengenharia is a student association within the Academic Association of the University of Algarve (AAUAlg). It represents and energises the students of the Bioengineering degree at the Faculty of Sciences and Technology, on the Gambelas Campus in Faro.
about.p2: Bioengineering brings together biology, biotechnology and engineering to solve real problems — from new materials and medical devices to sustainable bioprocesses and marine-based products. We want every student to make the most of this journey, inside and outside the classroom.
